verification_note:
Traffic Safe Subset V1 (legal-accuracy correction). An independent targeted legal review (VIETLAW_PUBLIC_BETA_V0_TRAFFIC_LEGAL_ACCURACY_REVIEW_V1.md) found all 11 original rules below legally unsafe to label CURATED_VERIFIED: 10 HIGH-severity findings (missing licence-point deductions, unresolved penalty bands, wrong vehicle-type scope, an unreferenced remediation claim) and 1 MEDIUM (helmet rule conflating driver/passenger). Every original rule was therefore set to status=disabled_pending_legal_correction and is never returned by TrafficSourcePack.find()/select_rule() -- see services/traffic_source_pack.py. Only four newly-authored, narrowly-scoped rules (red light: motorcycle/car; no-helmet: motorcycle driver only; hand-held phone use: motorcycle only) are status=enabled, each verified directly against the official VBPL full-text database (https://vbpl.vn/TW/Pages/vbpq-toanvan.aspx?ItemID=173920) and the Luat Trat tu, an toan giao thong duong bo 36/2024/QH15 (https://vbpl.vn/TW/Pages/vbpq-toanvan.aspx?ItemID=170620) for signal-priority rules, with explicit article/khoan/diem citations, licence-point deductions, and narrow exclusion conditions (traffic-controller override, accident-causing branch, yellow/flashing-yellow signal, wrong helmet subject, hands-free phone use) that route to GENERAL_GUIDANCE instead of guessing. alcohol/speeding/driver_license/passenger_limit/vehicle_modification remain entirely disabled in this task by design -- see the task's own explicit instruction not to repair all eight topics.

Legal Correction Round 1 (VIETLAW_TRAFFIC_SAFE_SUBSET_V1_LEGAL_REVIEW_V1.md): a targeted re-review of the resulting 4-rule Safe Subset V1 pack found 1 HIGH and 2 MEDIUM findings. HIGH-01: traffic_phone_use__motorcycle__handheld_safe_v1's selector could MATCH even when the user explicitly denied using the phone (holding it is not the same legal element as using it) -- disabled pending a phone_use fact with negation handling, out of scope for this round. MEDIUM-01: the pack carried only one structured citation per rule; the licence-point-deduction and (for red-light) Luật 36/2024/QH15 Điều 11 signal-priority bases were prose-only inside source_excerpt, with no separate official URL a user could open. Every enabled rule now carries a structured `legal_citations` list (one entry per independently traceable legal basis, each with its own document/article/clause/point/official_url), which is the source of truth for the rendered response; the legacy single article/clause/point fields are kept only for backward compatibility and mirror the primary_penalty citation. MEDIUM-02 (a runtime defect, not a data defect) is fixed in legal_fallback_orchestrator.py, not this file. Only 3 rules remain enabled: traffic_red_light__motorcycle__safe_v1, traffic_red_light__car__safe_v1, traffic_no_helmet__motorcycle__driver_safe_v1.

Người ngồi sau không đội mũ bảo hiểm, hoặc người lái chở người không đội mũ, thuộc các căn cứ khác (Điều 7 khoản 2 điểm i; Điều 12 khoản 5 điểm b) với các trường hợp loại trừ riêng (cấp cứu, trẻ dưới 6 tuổi, áp giải) chưa nằm trong phạm vi quy tắc này.

rules.disabled_reason: HIGH-01 (VIETLAW_TRAFFIC_SAFE_SUBSET_V1_LEGAL_REVIEW_V1.md): the selector's required facts (phone_handheld=yes, vehicle_in_operation=yes) prove only that the rider is holding the device while the vehicle is moving -- they do not prove the separate legal element of Điều 7 khoản 4 điểm đ, "sử dụng điện thoại hoặc thiết bị điện tử khác" (actually USING it). An adversarial probe ("Tôi dùng tay cầm điện thoại khi đang chạy xe máy nhưng chưa sử dụng điện thoại.") produced a MATCH despite the user explicitly denying use. Disabled pending a phone_use fact with negation/evidence handling; do not add such a fact or redesign phone classification in Legal Correction Round 1 -- out of scope for that task.
